region.why: a deployment fact: HCAZERRS ASSIGNs SYSID into the message it writes; the corpus names no region

notes: The example-health-apis threshold screen program HCT1PL01: a pseudo-conversation that RETURNs TRANSID(EIBTRNID) with its WORKING-STORAGE COMM-AREA (no DFHCOMMAREA, so the COMMAREA is a layout_only record, #7434). The HCT1 transaction inquires through HCP1BI01 / HCT1BI01, HCTA adds through HCT1BA01. Derived from IBM's example-health-apis (Apache-2.0; (C) Copyright IBM Corp. 2011, 2014): LICENSE here is the corpus's own, NOTICE names the source and what was derived. HCITDB01 DISPLAYs; the job log is compared too (the standalone Sysout honours gitgalaxy.sysout since #8246, port_blockers P128).

scenarios.name: inquire-threshold
scenarios.why: HCT1 with patient 2: the name and the seeded thresholds are shown

scenarios.name: inquire-no-threshold
scenarios.why: HCT1 with patient 1, who has no THRESHOLD row

scenarios.name: add-threshold
scenarios.why: HCTA with patient 1 and both readings: one THRESHOLD row inserted

scenarios.name: add-needs-readings
scenarios.why: HCTA with no readings: the prompt, no insert

scenarios.name: add-duplicate
scenarios.why: HCTA for patient 2, who has a row: the insert fails, rollback, error text

scenarios.name: other-transaction
scenarios.why: a transaction that is neither: the plain RETURN

scenarios.name: pf3
scenarios.why: HANDLE AID PF3: the first-entry map is sent, then ENDIT sends the end text and RETURNs

scenarios.name: pf12
scenarios.why: HANDLE AID PF12: CANCELIT RETURNs TRANSID HCAZ IMMEDIATE

scenarios.name: clear
scenarios.why: HANDLE AID CLEAR: CLEARIT sends the map MAPONLY and RETURNs TRANSID(EIBTRNID)

scenarios.name: mapfail
scenarios.why: no input: RECEIVE MAP raises MAPFAIL, HANDLE CONDITION sends ENDIT
